data_table.description: A stand-in pheno table covering the digest shapes the reader has to handle.

variable.name: HEIGHT
variable.description: Standing height, declared string but measured integer.

variable.name: YEAR
variable.description: Year of the exam; dbGaP emits the value with no code attribute.

variable.name: DUPCODE
variable.description: Two values sharing one code, as dbGaP sometimes publishes.

variable.name: BOUNDED
variable.description: Declares logical bounds; its var_report row carries no stat element.

variable.name: SENTINEL
variable.description: A numeric measurement carrying one out-of-band marker among its values.
